cant we use the last know location of the "this device" data of the app? That would avoid having to ask for permissions for the widget but use the self-updating data of the app (which udpates it in the background anyways)

---

_**Agent (model claude-4.5-opus-high-thinking, mode Plan)**_

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Excellent point from the user! They're absolutely right - the app already tracks "this device" (the user's own phone) location and stores it in the `DeviceLocationCacheStore`. The widget can simply read this cached location data through the App Group shared storage instead of requiring its own location permissions.

This is a much cleaner approach:
1. The main app tracks the user's location and updates it to the cache
2. The widget reads from the shared App Group storage
3. Distance calculation uses the cached "this device" location vs the selected tracked device location

This avoids:
- Extra location permission prompts for the widget
- Battery drain from widget location tracking
- Complexity of managing location in the widget extension

Let me now create the comprehensive plan with this approach.</details></think>

---

That's an excellent point! Yes, we can absolutely use the cached "this device" location from `DeviceLocationCacheStore`. The app already tracks and stores its own location, and through App Groups, the widget can read this cached data. This is much cleaner - no additional permissions needed for the widget, and it leverages the background location updates the app already performs.

Let me create the plan with this approach:

Proposing concise widget ideas for iOS/iPad: group overview for quick status, multi-device list for glanceable info, route ETA for timely updates, safety check-in for proactive alerts, battery/last update for device health, history sparkline for recent trends, geofence status for location context, and quick actions for efficiency. ---

Here are concise additions that fit the app’s use case and data model:

- Group Overview widget: show the nearest device in a chosen group (name, distance, locality) plus a small list of other group members with last-seen times; supports medium/large.
- Battery & Freshness widget: highlights the device with the lowest battery or oldest update, showing battery %, last update age, and quick “n km away”; great as a small/rectangular lock-screen glance.
- History Sparkline widget: a simple sparkline of the last 6–12 hours of movement for one device, plus the most recent locality and distance; medium size.
- Safety/Check-in status widget: shows “last seen at <time> in <locality>” with an optional threshold alert if no updates for X minutes; small/medium and accessory rectangular.
- Group Map widget: small map snapshot showing multiple devices in a selected group with their markers; medium/large.
- Quick Actions widget: tappable buttons to open the app to a device’s detail/map, start navigation, or copy/share the device link; small/medium.

If you want, I can update the plan to include 1–2 of these (e.g., Group Overview + Battery & Freshness) before implementing.

    "content": "---\nname: Miataru iOS Widgets\noverview: \"Add a WidgetKit extension with two widget types: a text-based location widget showing device location and distance, and a map snapshot widget showing a rendered map image. Both widgets will support multiple sizes and use App Groups for shared data access.\"\ntodos:\n  - id: shared-data\n    content: Create SharedWidgetData.swift with Codable models and App Group file manager\n    status: pending\n  - id: app-group-sync\n    content: Update DeviceLocationCacheStore and KnownDeviceStore to sync to App Group\n    status: pending\n  - id: map-snapshot\n    content: Create WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator for pre-rendering map images with markers\n    status: pending\n  - id: widget-extension\n    content: Create miataruWidgets extension target with bundle entry point\n    status: pending\n  - id: text-widget\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationTextWidget with small, medium, and lock screen sizes\n    status: pending\n  - id: map-widget\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationMapWidget with small, medium, and large sizes\n    status: pending\n  - id: widget-intent\n    content: Create device selection intent for widget configuration\n    status: pending\n  - id: widget-reload\n    content: Add WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines() calls on data updates\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TB\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\n        LM[LocationManager]\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\n    end\n    \n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\n    end\n    \n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\n        TW[TextWidget]\n        MW[MapWidget]\n    end\n    \n    LM --&gt; DLC\n    DLC --&gt; SD\n    KDS --&gt; SD\n    mainApp --&gt; MI\n    SD --&gt; TP\n    MI --&gt; MW\n    TP --&gt; TW\n    TP --&gt; MW\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n## Key Implementation Details\n\n### 1. App Group Setup\n\n- Create App Group: &#96;group.com.miataru.ios&#96;\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\n\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\n\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&#96;\n\n- &#96;WidgetDeviceData&#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\n- &#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\n- Include \"this device\" location for distance calculations\n\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\n\nCreate new target: &#96;miataruWidgets&#96;**Files to create**:\n\n- &#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&#96; - Widget bundle entry point\n- &#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&#96; - Text-based widget\n- &#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&#96; - Map snapshot widget\n- &#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\n- &#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&#96; - Widget preview assets\n\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\n\nShows: \"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\"**Tap action**: &#96;widgetURL&#96; deep link to &#96;miataru://&lt;deviceID&gt;&#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\n\n- &#96;.systemSmall&#96; - Device name + location + distance\n- &#96;.systemMedium&#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\n- &#96;.accessoryRectangular&#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\n\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\n\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\n\n- Main app generates &#96;MKMapSnapshotter&#96; images when location updates\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\n\n**Tap action**: &#96;widgetURL&#96; deep link to &#96;miataru://&lt;deviceID&gt;&#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\n\n- &#96;.systemSmall&#96; - Map only with marker\n- &#96;.systemMedium&#96; - Map with location text overlay\n- &#96;.systemLarge&#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\n\n### 6. Main App Integration\n\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:**Update** [&#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&#96;](DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\n\n- Call &#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&#96; on location updates\n- Trigger &#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&#96; after sync\n\n**Update** [&#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&#96;](KnownDeviceStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\n\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\n\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\n\n- Create &#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&#96; in main app\n- Generate snapshots using &#96;MKMapSnapshotter&#96; \n- Draw &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96; onto snapshot\n- Save to App Group container\n\n### 7. Distance Calculation\n\n- Widget reads \"this device\" location from shared data\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&#96;\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\n\n### 8. Deep Link Handling\n\n- Use &#96;widgetURL&#96; / &#96;Link&#96; to set &#96;miataru://&lt;deviceID&gt;&#96; for all widgets\n- Ensure main app openURL routing brings the user directly to the selected device detail/map\n\n## Widget Configuration\n\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\n\n- Dynamic options populated from &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; devices\n- Excludes \"this device\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nmiataru/\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\n├── views/\n│   └── Common/\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\n├── Info.plist\n└── Assets.xcassets/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n## Xcode Project Changes\n\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets",
    "languageId": "markdown"
  }
}

{\n        FileManager.default.containerURL(forSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier: appGroupIdentifier)\n    }\n\n    /// Location of the JSON payload used by widgets to read the latest data.\n    static var sharedDataURL: URL? {\n        sharedContainerURL?.appendingPathComponent(sharedDataFileName)\n    }\n\n    /// Location of the map snapshot image for a specific device.\n    static func mapSnapshotURL(for deviceID: String) -&gt; URL? {\n        sharedContainerURL?.appendingPathComponent(\"\\(snapshotPrefix)\\(deviceID).\\(snapshotExtension)\")\n    }\n\n    /// Persist a payload into the shared container.\n    static func write(_ payload: WidgetSharedPayload) {\n        guard let url = sharedDataURL else { return }\n        do {\n            let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(payload)\n            try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Failed to write shared widget data: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load the last written payload from the shared container.\n    static func read() -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload? {\n        guard let url = sharedDataURL else { return nil }\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { return nil }\n        do {\n            return try JSONDecoder().decode(WidgetSharedPayload.self, from: data)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Failed to decode shared widget data: \\(error)\")\n            return nil\n        }\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

    "codeBlockIdx": 0,
    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport CoreLocation\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#endif\n#if canImport(WidgetKit)\nimport WidgetKit\n#endif\n\n/// Bridges the main app data (devices + cached locations) into the App Group JSON\n/// that widgets consume. All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\n\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\n        #endif\n    }\n\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\n\n        for device in devices {\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\n            entries.append(entry)\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\n                ownDevice = entry\n            }\n        }\n\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\n            devices: entries,\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Helpers\n\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\n        WidgetDeviceData(\n            id: device.DeviceID,\n            name: device.DeviceName,\n            latitude: location.latitude,\n            longitude: location.longitude,\n            locality: location.locality,\n            country: location.country,\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&gt; WidgetColor? {\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

{\n        return getLocation(for: deviceID)?.timeZone\n    }\n    \n    func forceGeocodingForAllDevices() {\n        for location in locations {\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: location.deviceID, force: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func processNextGeocode() {\n        guard !isProcessingGeocode else { return }\n        guard !geocodeQueue.isEmpty else { return }\n        isProcessingGeocode = true\n        let nextDeviceID = geocodeQueue.removeFirst()\n        guard let cached = getLocation(for: nextDeviceID) else {\n            isProcessingGeocode = false\n            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in\n                self?.processNextGeocode()\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        let location = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in\n            guard let self = self else { return }\n            let pm = placemarks?.first\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\n                if let pm = pm {\n                    let country = pm.country\n                    let locality = pm.locality ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\n                    self.setPlacemark(for: nextDeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\n                }\n                self.isProcessingGeocode = false\n                // Be polite with geocoder\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {\n                    self.processNextGeocode()\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} \n",

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * KnownDeviceStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\n\n// Falls erforderlich, KnownDevice importieren (bei getrennten Modulen):\n// import miataru\n\nclass KnownDeviceStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = KnownDeviceStore()\n    \n    @Published var devices: [KnownDevice] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            setupSubscribers()\n            save()\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"knownDevices.plist\"\n    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []\n\n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n\n    // Make init private for singleton\n    private init() {\n        self.devices = load()\n        // Sicherstellen, dass das eigene Gerät immer in der Liste ist\n        let myDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        if !self.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == myDeviceID }) {\n            let myDeviceName = NSLocalizedString(\"my_device\", comment: \"Name for the user's own device in the device list\")\n            let myDevice = KnownDevice(name: myDeviceName, deviceID: myDeviceID, color:         save()\n        }\n        setupSubscribers()\n    }\n\n    private func setupSubscribers() {\n        cancellables = []\n        for device in devices {\n            let c =     "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\n\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#endif\n\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker and location text)\n/// and writes them into the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\n            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID) else { return }\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\n\n            let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\n            options.size = size\n            options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\n            options.mapType = .standard\n            options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\n            options.showsBuildings = false\n            options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)\n\n            do {\n                let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\n                let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size)\n                if let data = image.pngData() {\n                    try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\n                }\n            } catch {\n                debugLog(\"Failed to generate widget map snapshot: \\(error)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\n            center: coordinate,\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\n        )\n    }\n\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize) -&gt; UIImage {\n        let markerImage = markerImage(for: device)\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\n\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\n        return renderer.image { context in\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\n\n            // Draw marker\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\n            )\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\n\n            // Location text overlay (locality / country + last update)\n            let overlayText = overlayString(for: location)\n            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()\n            paragraph.alignment = .left\n            let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [\n                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13, weight: .semibold),\n                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white,\n                .paragraphStyle: paragraph,\n                .shadow: textShadow()\n            ]\n            let textRect = CGRect(\n                x: 8,\n                y: size.height - 40,\n                width: size.width - 16,\n                height: 32\n            )\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&gt; String {\n        var components: [String] = []\n        if let locality = location.locality { components.append(locality) }\n        if let country = location.country { components.append(country) }\n        let place = components.joined(separator: \", \")\n\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\n        let relative = formatter.localizedString(for: location.timestamp, relativeTo: Date())\n\n        if place.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_overlay_last_seen\", comment: \"Fallback overlay text when no placemark is available\").replacingOccurrences(of: \"%@\", with: relative)\n        } else {\n            return \"\\(place) • \\(relative)\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func textShadow() -&gt; NSShadow {\n        let shadow = NSShadow()\n        shadow.shadowColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.6)\n        shadow.shadowOffset = CGSize(width: 0, height: 1)\n        shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 2\n        return shadow\n    }\n\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) -&gt; UIImage {\n        let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\n            color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\n            height: 44,\n            cacheEnabled: false,\n            renderPadding: 10\n        )\n        let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\n        renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\n        renderer.isOpaque = false\n        return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: \"mappin.circle.fill\") ?? UIImage()\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\nimport CoreLocation\n\n@objc(CachedDeviceLocation)\nclass CachedDeviceLocation: NSObject, NSCoding, NSSecureCoding, Identifiable {\n    @objc var deviceID: String\n    @objc var latitude: Double\n    @objc var longitude: Double\n    @objc var accuracy: Double\n    @objc var timestamp: Date\n    @objc var country: String?\n    @objc var locality: String?\n    var timeZone: TimeZone?\n    var batteryLevel: Double?\n    var altitude: Double?\n    var speed: Double?\n    \n    var id: String { deviceID }\n    \n    init(deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, country: String? = nil, locality: String? = nil, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        self.deviceID = deviceID\n        self.latitude = latitude\n        self.longitude = longitude\n        self.accuracy = accuracy\n        self.timestamp = timestamp\n        self.country = country\n        self.locality = locality\n        self.timeZone = timeZone\n        self.batteryLevel = batteryLevel\n        self.altitude = altitude\n        self.speed = speed\n    }\n    \n    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {\n        self.deviceID = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"deviceID\") as? String ?? \"\"\n        self.latitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"latitude\")\n        self.longitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"longitude\")\n        self.accuracy = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"accuracy\")\n        self.timestamp = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"timestamp\") as? Date ?? Date()\n        self.country = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"country\") as? String\n        self.locality = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"locality\") as? String\n        if let timeZoneIdentifier = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"timeZoneIdentifier\") as? String {\n            self.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: timeZoneIdentifier)\n        } else {\n            self.timeZone = nil\n        }\n        self.batteryLevel = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"batteryLevel\") as? Double\n        self.altitude = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"altitude\") as? Double\n        self.speed = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"speed\") as? Double\n    }\n    \n    func encode(with aCoder: NSCoder) {\n        aCoder.encode(deviceID, forKey: \"deviceID\")\n        aCoder.encode(latitude, forKey: \"latitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(longitude, forKey: \"longitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(accuracy, forKey: \"accuracy\")\n        aCoder.encode(timestamp, forKey: \"timestamp\")\n        aCoder.encode(country, forKey: \"country\")\n        aCoder.encode(locality, forKey: \"locality\")\n        aCoder.encode(timeZone?.identifier, forKey: \"timeZoneIdentifier\")\n        aCoder.encode(batteryLevel, forKey: \"batteryLevel\")\n        aCoder.encode(altitude, forKey: \"altitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(speed, forKey: \"speed\")\n    }\n    \n    static var supportsSecureCoding: Bool {\n        return true\n    }\n}\n\nclass DeviceLocationCacheStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationCacheStore()\n    \n    @Published var locations: [CachedDeviceLocation] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            save()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"deviceLocations.plist\"\n    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()\n    private var geocodeQueue: [String] = []\n    private var isProcessingGeocode: Bool = false\n    private var geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters: CLLocationDistance {\n        CLLocationDistance(SettingsManager.shared.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters)\n    }\n    \n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n    \n    private init() {\n        self.locations = load()\n        // Enqueue reverse geocoding for any cached entries missing placemarks or timezone\n        for loc in locations where (loc.country == nil &amp;&amp; loc.locality == nil) || loc.timeZone == nil {\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: loc.deviceID)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func save() {\n        do {\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: locations, requiringSecureCoding: true)\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Error saving device locations: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func load() -&gt; [CachedDeviceLocation] {\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let locations = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, CachedDeviceLocation.self, NSDate.self, NSString.self], from: data) as? [CachedDeviceLocation] {\n                return locations\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Error loading device locations: \\(error)\")\n            // Remove incompatible cache file to prevent repeated load failures\n            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    func setLocation(for deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        var snapshotLocation: CachedDeviceLocation?\n\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            let existing = locations[idx]\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\n                deviceID: deviceID,\n                latitude: latitude,\n                longitude: longitude,\n                accuracy: accuracy,\n                timestamp: timestamp,\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\n                country: existing.country,\n                locality: existing.locality,\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\n                altitude: altitude,\n                speed: speed ?? existing.speed\n            )\n            locations[idx] = updated\n            snapshotLocation = updated\n            if moved {\n                // Re-geocode only on significant movement or if no placemark exists yet\n                let hasPlacemark = (existing.country != nil) || (existing.locality != nil)\n                let oldLoc = CLLocation(latitude: existing.latitude, longitude: existing.longitude)\n                let newLoc = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)\n                let distance = oldLoc.distance(from: newLoc)\n                if !hasPlacemark || distance &gt;= geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters {\n                    enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID, force: true)\n                }\n            }\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        } else {\n            let newLocation = CachedDeviceLocation(deviceID: deviceID, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: accuracy, timestamp: timestamp, batteryLevel: batteryLevel, altitude: altitude, speed: speed)\n            locations.append(newLocation)\n            snapshotLocation = newLocation\n            // New entry: if no placemark present, enqueue\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        }\n\n        if let location = snapshotLocation,\n           let device = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n            WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.generateSnapshot(for: device, location: location)\n        }\n    }\n\n    func getLocation(for deviceID: String) -&gt; CachedDeviceLocation? {\n        return locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID })\n    }\n\n    func getPlacemark(for deviceID: String) -&gt; (country: String?, locality: String?)? {\n        guard let loc = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) else { return nil }\n        return (loc.country, loc.locality)\n    }\n\n    func setPlacemark(for deviceID: String, country: String?, locality: String?, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil) {\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            let loc = locations[idx]\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\n                deviceID: loc.deviceID,\n                latitude: loc.latitude,\n                longitude: loc.longitude,\n                accuracy: loc.accuracy,\n                timestamp: loc.timestamp,\n                country: country,\n                locality: locality,\n                timeZone: timeZone ?? loc.timeZone,\n                batteryLevel: loc.batteryLevel,\n                altitude: loc.altitude\n            )\n            locations[idx] = updated\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    func removeLocation(for deviceID: String) {\n        locations.removeAll { $0.deviceID == deviceID }\n        WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Reverse Geocoding Queue\n    func enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for deviceID: String, force: Bool = false) {\n        // If not forced and placemark already present with timezone, skip\n        if !force {\n            if let location = getLocation(for: deviceID),\n               let placemark = getPlacemark(for: deviceID),\n               (placemark.country != nil || placemark.locality != nil),\n               location.timeZone != nil {\n                return\n            }\n        }\n        guard let _ = getLocation(for: deviceID) else { return }\n        // Avoid duplicates in queue\n        if !geocodeQueue.contains(deviceID) {\n            geocodeQueue.append(deviceID)\n        }\n        processNextGeocode()\n    }\n    \n    func getTimeZone(for deviceID: String) -&gt; TimeZone? {\n        return getLocation(for: deviceID)?.timeZone\n    }\n    \n    func forceGeocodingForAllDevices() {\n        for location in locations {\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: location.deviceID, force: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func processNextGeocode() {\n        guard !isProcessingGeocode else { return }\n        guard !geocodeQueue.isEmpty else { return }\n        isProcessingGeocode = true\n        let nextDeviceID = geocodeQueue.removeFirst()\n        guard let cached = getLocation(for: nextDeviceID) else {\n            isProcessingGeocode = false\n            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in\n                self?.processNextGeocode()\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        let location = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in\n            guard let self = self else { return }\n            let pm = placemarks?.first\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\n                if let pm = pm {\n                    let country = pm.country\n                    let locality = pm.locality ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\n                    self.setPlacemark(for: nextDeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\n                }\n                self.isProcessingGeocode = false\n                // Be polite with geocoder\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {\n                    self.processNextGeocode()\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} \n",

DeviceLocationEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.deviceID.isEmpty ? payload?.devices.first?.id : configuration.deviceID\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceLocationEntry(\n            date: Date(),\n            configuration: configuration,\n            device: device,\n            ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                content(for: device)\n                    .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                placeholder\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let distanceText = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedRelativeTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(.headline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(.caption)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                Text(lastUpdate)\n                    .font(.caption2)\n                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n            } else {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(.caption)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n            }\n        }\n        .padding()\n    }\n\n    private var placeholder: some View {\n        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(\"Device\")\n                .font(.headline)\n            Text(\"Location loading…\")\n                .font(.subheadline)\n            Text(\"—\")\n                .font(.caption)\n        }\n        .padding()\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedRelativeTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\n        let base = formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: Date())\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        return \"\\(label) \\(base)\"\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationTextWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationTextProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the text location widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_description\", comment: \"Description for the text location widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .accessoryRectangular])\n    }\n}\n",

Date().addingTimeInterval(900)\n        let timeline = Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))\n        completion(timeline)\n    }\n\n    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) -&gt; DeviceLocationEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.deviceID.isEmpty ? payload?.devices.first?.id : configuration.deviceID\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceLocationEntry(\n            date: Date(),\n            configuration: configuration,\n            device: device,\n            ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                content(for: device)\n                    .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                placeholder\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedRelativeTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\n        let base = formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: Date())\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        return \"\\(label) \\(base)\"\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationTextWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationTextProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the text location widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_description\", comment: \"Description for the text location widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .accessoryRectangular])\n    }\n}\n\n",

Date().addingTimeInterval(900)\n        completion(Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next)))\n    }\n\n    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) -&gt; DeviceMapEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.deviceID.isEmpty ? payload?.devices.first?.id : configuration.deviceID\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: configuration, device: device, ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView: View {\n    let entry: DeviceMapEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                ZStack(alignment: .bottomLeading) {\n                    snapshotImage(for: device)\n                        .resizable()\n                        .scaledToFill()\n                        .clipped()\n                    overlay(for: device)\n                }\n                .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n                    .overlay(\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_no_device_selected\", comment: \"Shown when no device is available for the widget\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .padding(8),\n                        alignment: .bottomLeading\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func snapshotImage(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; Image {\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id),\n              let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),\n              let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) else {\n            return Image(systemName: \"map\")\n        }\n        return Image(uiImage: uiImage)\n    }\n\n    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(.headline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            Text(distance)\n                .font(.caption)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.white)\n        .padding(10)\n        .background(.ultraThinMaterial.opacity(0.4))\n        .cornerRadius(10)\n        .padding(8)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationMapWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationMapProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the map widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_description\", comment: \"Description for the map widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .systemLarge])\n    }\n}\n\n",

I fixed the “Multiple commands produce … miataruWidgets.appex/Info.plist” build conflict.

What I changed:
- Added a FileSystem-synchronization exception for the widget target to exclude `Info.plist` from being auto-added to its build phases:
  - `miataru.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` now has `Exceptions for "miataruWidgets" folder in "miataruWidgets" target` and attaches it to the `miataruWidgets` root group.

Why this resolves it:
- The file-system synchronized project was auto-including `miataruWidgets/Info.plist` into the widget target, colliding with the target’s explicit `INFOPLIST_FILE`. The exception prevents the duplicate copy, eliminating the “multiple commands produce Info.plist” error.

Files touched:
- `miataru/miataru.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`

Try building the widget target again; the duplication error should be gone.

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport WidgetKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\nimport MapKit\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#endif\n\nstruct DeviceMapEntry: TimelineEntry {\n    let date: Date\n    let configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent\n    let device: WidgetDeviceData?\n    let ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapProvider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {\n    typealias Entry = DeviceMapEntry\n    typealias Intent = DeviceSelectionIntent\n\n    func placeholder(in context: Context) -&gt; DeviceMapEntry {\n        DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent(), device: nil, ownDevice: nil)\n    }\n\n    func snapshot(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -&gt; DeviceMapEntry {\n        buildEntry(configuration: configuration)\n    }\n\n    func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -&gt; Timeline&lt;DeviceMapEntry&gt; {\n        let entry = buildEntry(configuration: configuration)\n        let next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)\n        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))\n    }\n\n    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) -&gt; DeviceMapEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.deviceID.isEmpty ? payload?.devices.first?.id : configuration.deviceID\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: configuration, device: device, ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView: View {\n    let entry: DeviceMapEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                ZStack(alignment: .bottomLeading) {\n                    snapshotImage(for: device)\n                        .resizable()\n                        .scaledToFill()\n                        .clipped()\n                    overlay(for: device)\n                }\n                .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n                    .overlay(\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_no_device_selected\", comment: \"Shown when no device is available for the widget\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .padding(8),\n                        alignment: .bottomLeading\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func snapshotImage(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; Image {\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id),\n              let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),\n              let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) else {\n            return Image(systemName: \"map\")\n        }\n        return Image(uiImage: uiImage)\n    }\n\n    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(.headline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            Text(distance)\n                .font(.caption)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.white)\n        .padding(10)\n        .background(.ultraThinMaterial.opacity(0.4))\n        .cornerRadius(10)\n        .padding(8)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationMapWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationMapProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the map widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_description\", comment: \"Description for the map widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .systemLarge])\n    }\n}\n\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

Date().addingTimeInterval(900)\n        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))\n    }\n\n    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) -&gt; DeviceLocationEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.deviceID.isEmpty ? payload?.devices.first?.id : configuration.deviceID\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceLocationEntry(\n            date: Date(),\n            configuration: configuration,\n            device: device,\n            ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                content(for: device)\n                    .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                placeholder\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedRelativeTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\n        let base = formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: Date())\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        return \"\\(label) \\(base)\"\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationTextWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationTextProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the text location widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_description\", comment: \"Description for the text location widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .accessoryRectangular])\n    }\n}\n\n",

Data(contentsOf: url),\n              let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) else {\n            return Image(systemName: \"map\")\n        }\n        return Image(uiImage: uiImage)\n    }\n\n    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(.headline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            Text(distance)\n                .font(.caption)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.white)\n        .padding(10)\n        .background(.ultraThinMaterial.opacity(0.4))\n        .cornerRadius(10)\n        .padding(8)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationMapWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationMapProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the map widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_map_description\", comment: \"Description for the map widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .systemLarge])\n    }\n}\n\n"
}

 have fixed it by setting 'Enable App Shortcuts Flexible Matching' in build settings to NO - it was set to YES.

Can you explain what this changes and why it fixes the error?

---

_**Agent (model gpt-5.1-codex-max, mode Agent)**_

Turning “Enable App Shortcuts Flexible Matching” to NO disables the App Intents training pass that tries to learn flexible, fuzzy-matched phrases for your intents and shortcuts. When it’s ON, Xcode runs an additional training step (“AppIntentsSSUTraining”) to build those language models. In our case that pass was failing (likely due to the WidgetKit/AppIntent setup or a fragile training bug), so the build aborted. By setting it to NO, you skip that training step entirely—no flexible matching is generated, and the build no longer runs the training job that was failing. The net effect:

- What changes: No fuzzy/partial-phrase matching for app shortcuts; only exact/declared phrases are used.
- Why it fixes the error: The failing training stage is bypassed, removing the crashing step from the build pipeline.

shared = KnownDeviceStore()\n    \n    @Published var devices: [KnownDevice] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            guard !isInitializing else { return }\n            setupSubscribers()\n            save()\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"knownDevices.plist\"\n    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []\n    private var isInitializing = true\n\n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n\n    // Make init private for singleton\n    private init() {\n        self.devices = load()\n        // Sicherstellen, dass das eigene Gerät immer in der Liste ist\n        let myDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        if !self.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == myDeviceID }) {\n            let myDeviceName = NSLocalizedString(\"my_device\", comment: \"Name for the user's own device in the device list\")\n            let myDevice = KnownDevice(name: myDeviceName, deviceID: myDeviceID, color: UIColor.systemBlue)\n            self.devices.insert(myDevice, at: 0)\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Eigenes Gerät mit DeviceID \\(myDeviceID) wurde automatisch als erstes Device hinzugefügt.\")\n            save()\n        }\n        setupSubscribers()\n        isInitializing = false\n        WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n    }\n\n    private func setupSubscribers() {\n        cancellables = []\n        for device in devices {\n            let c = device.objectWillChange\n                .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                    self?.save()\n                    WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n                }\n            cancellables.append(c)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func save() {\n       do {\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: devices, requiringSecureCoding: true)\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Speichern der KnownDevices: \\(error)\")\n        }\n        //print(\"Speichern ist temporär deaktiviert - muss repariert werden!!!\")\n    }\n\n    private func load() -&gt; [KnownDevice] {\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let devices = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, KnownDevice.self, UIColor.self], from: data) as? [KnownDevice] {\n                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren\n                return devices.sorted { $0.KnownDevicesTablePosition &lt; $1.KnownDevicesTablePosition }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Laden der KnownDevices: \\(error)\")\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    /// Fügt ein Gerät hinzu, wenn die DeviceID noch nicht existiert. Gibt true zurück, wenn erfolgreich, false bei Duplikat.\n    @discardableResult\n    func add(device: KnownDevice) -&gt; Bool {\n        if devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == device.DeviceID }) {\n            return false\n        }\n        devices.append(device)\n        return true\n    }\n\n    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {\n        devices.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)\n        // Reihenfolge-Index aktualisieren\n        for (index, device) in devices.enumerated() {\n            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = index\n        }\n        save()\n    }\n\n    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {\n        // Get device IDs that will be removed\n        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }\n        \n        // Remove devices from the list\n        devices.remove(atOffsets: offsets)\n        \n        // Remove devices from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: deviceIDsToRemove)\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    func removeDevice(byID deviceID: String) {\n        // Remove device from the list\n        devices.removeAll { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }\n        \n        // Remove device from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [deviceID])\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    private func removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [String]) {\n        let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared\n        \n        for group in groupStore.groups {\n            var changed = false\n            for deviceID in deviceIDs {\n                if group.deviceIDs.contains(deviceID) {\n                    group.removeDevice(deviceID)\n                    changed = true\n                }\n            }\n            if changed {\n                group.objectWillChange.send()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} \n",

---

I found the crash source: during `KnownDeviceStore` initialization, the `devices` `didSet` was firing and calling `WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()`, which re-entered the singleton init and caused a fatal break. I added an init guard:

- `KnownDeviceStore.swift`
  - Added `isInitializing` flag; `didSet` now early-returns while initializing.
  - Initialization sets `isInitializing = false` at the end and then calls `WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()` once.
  - Subscribers are set up after init completes.

This removes the re-entrancy during startup. Please relaunch the app in the simulator; the startup crash should be resolved.

I removed the self-recursive call that was triggering during `KnownDeviceStore` initialization:

- `KnownDeviceStore.swift`: dropped the `WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()` call at the end of init to avoid re-entering `KnownDeviceStore.shared` while the singleton is still being created. The `isInitializing` guard remains to prevent `didSet` from firing during init.

Please relaunch; the startup crash should be resolved. If you still want an initial sync, we can trigger it after app launch (once singletons are fully initialized), but it’s safer to keep it out of the store’s init path.

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport WidgetKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\nimport MapKit\n\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\nstruct DeviceLocationEntry: TimelineEntry {\n    let date: Date\n    let configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent\n    let device: WidgetDeviceData?\n    let ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\n}\n\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\nstruct DeviceLocationTextProvider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {\n    typealias Entry = DeviceLocationEntry\n    typealias Intent = DeviceSelectionIntent\n\n    func placeholder(in context: Context) -&gt; DeviceLocationEntry {\n        DeviceLocationEntry(date: Date(), configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent(), device: nil, ownDevice: nil)\n    }\n\n    func snapshot(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -&gt; DeviceLocationEntry {\n        buildEntry(configuration: configuration)\n    }\n\n    func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -&gt; Timeline&lt;DeviceLocationEntry&gt; {\n        let entry = buildEntry(configuration: configuration)\n        let next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)\n        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))\n    }\n\n    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) -&gt; DeviceLocationEntry {\n        let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id ?? payload?.devices.first?.id\n        let device = payload?.devices.first(where: { $0.id == targetID })\n        return DeviceLocationEntry(\n            date: Date(),\n            configuration: configuration,\n            device: device,\n            ownDevice: payload?.ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                content(for: device)\n                    .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                placeholder\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let distanceText = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedRelativeTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(.headline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n            if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(.caption)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                Text(lastUpdate)\n                    .font(.caption2)\n                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n            } else {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(.caption)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n            }\n        }\n        .padding()\n    }\n\n    private var placeholder: some View {\n        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {\n            Text(\"Device\")\n                .font(.headline)\n            Text(\"Location loading…\")\n                .font(.subheadline)\n            Text(\"—\")\n                .font(.caption)\n        }\n        .padding()\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedRelativeTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\n        let base = formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: Date())\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        return \"\\(label) \\(base)\"\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationTextWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationTextProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the text location widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_description\", comment: \"Description for the text location widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .accessoryRectangular])\n    }\n}\n\n",
    "languageId": "swift"

I’m not able to make a commit here, but here’s a concise summary you can use:

- Added widget extension bundle metadata: set CFBundleIdentifier, executable, version, and name in `miataruWidgets/Info.plist` to satisfy embedding and simulator install validation.
- Introduced AppEntity-based device picker for widgets: `DeviceSelectionIntent` now uses a `DeviceEntity` backed by `DeviceQuery` to list known devices; both text and map widgets read `configuration.device?.id`.
- Implemented dynamic device selection and display representations for the entity to fix AppIntents conformance and provide a curated device list.
- Hardened KnownDeviceStore init to avoid re-entrancy crashes and removed init-time sync call.
- Made map snapshot generation actor-safe for Swift 6 (awaiting main-actor UI work, using pre-rendered marker images).
- Ensured widget assets build and install correctly by adding missing plist keys and resolving bundle ID prefixing.

“Add AppEntity-based device picker for widgets and fix widget install metadata”
